summary: Pharming Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, attaching a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announcing positive Phase II topline data for leniolisib in genetically identifiable primary immunodeficiencies with immune dysregulation beyond APDS, presented as a late-breaking poster at ESID 2026 in Maastricht. The single-arm, open-label, intra-patient dose-escalation study enrolled 13 participants across CTLA4, SOCS1, NFKB1 and FAS genotypes, dosing 10 mg then 30 mg then 70 mg twice daily over 20 weeks. This is a routine clinical-results disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is stated. Watch further clinical and regulatory updates.
